headline: Premier League Friday: Ipswich host Forest at Portman Road to open Matchweek 8
whyCareReason: Matchweek 8 kicks off tonight at Portman Road. Forest sit 19th on 5 points, Ipswich 12th on 8.
teaser: Friday 23 October, 20:00 UK, Portman Road, Sky Sports. City lead table on 21; Chelsea host Spurs on Saturday.
story: Matchweek 8 of the Premier League opens Friday night, 23 October, under the Portman Road lights as Ipswich Town host Nottingham Forest at 20:00 UK. Ipswich enter in 12th place with 8 points from seven matches (2-2-3), having challenged Manchester City in a 3-2 defeat last weekend. Forest sit 19th in the relegation zone on 5 points (1-2-4) following a narrow 1-0 defeat to Arsenal. Manchester City top the table with a perfect 21 points, three clear of Arsenal on 18. Saturday brings the headline London derby between Chelsea and Tottenham at Stamford Bridge.
stakes: Forest fight to climb out of the bottom three while Ipswich aim to solidify their mid-table position.
rivalryAngle: Friday night football under the Portman Road floodlights opens Matchweek 8.
